specs.Item Highlight: 1250 ANSI Lumens with Cross Matrix LED delivers bright, vivid visuals for movies, gaming and presentations.

features: Brilliant 1250 ANSI Brightness : Powered by Cross Matrix LED technology, delivering bright, vivid, and detailed visuals with 1250 ANSI lumens for movies, gaming, and presentations.
Native Full HD Cinematic Display : Enjoy crystal-clear 1920 × 1080 Full HD resolution with a massive projection size of up to 250 inches and 97% DCI-P3 wide color gamut.
Smart Android 13 Entertainment : Built-in Android 13 provides a smooth smart experience with access to your favorite streaming apps including Netflix, Prime Video, and YouTube.
Effortless Setup & Image Alignment : Electric Focus, Electric 4D Keystone Correction, Auto Screen Fit, and Obstacle Avoidance ensure a perfectly aligned image in seconds.
Premium Optical Performance : Features a 9-layer all-glass lens, fully enclosed dustproof optical engine, and self-cleaning dust door for long-lasting image quality.
Fast Connectivity & Immersive Audio : Dual-Band Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, HDMI ARC, USB multimedia playback, and a powerful 5W speaker provide seamless entertainment.
Built to Last : Up to 40,000-hour LED life with a durable optical engine and backed by a 1-year manufacturer warranty for reliable performance.
Portable & Easy to Carry : Compact and lightweight design makes the PIXPAQ POWER BOOST ideal for home entertainment, office presentations, travel, classrooms, and outdoor movie nights.
description: Transform your home entertainment with the PIXPAQ POWER BOOST, a premium smart projector engineered to deliver brighter visuals, vibrant colors, and an immersive big-screen experience. Powered by Cross Matrix LED technology with an impressive 1250 ANSI Lumens, it produces exceptional brightness and clarity for movies, sports, gaming, and business presentations. Experience true cinematic quality with Native Full HD 1080p resolution, 97% DCI-P3 wide color gamut, and a massive 250-inch projection, bringing every scene to life with stunning detail and lifelike colors. The Premium 9-Layer All-Glass Lens and Fully Enclosed Dustproof Optical Engine ensure sharp images while protecting the projector from dust for long-lasting performance. Running on Android 13, the POWER BOOST offers a smooth smart TV experience with access to your favorite streaming apps. Electric Focus and Electric 4D Keystone Correction make setup quick and effortless, while Auto Screen Fit and Obstacle Avoidance help optimize image placement.
